field_descriptions.application_category: Type of software application, e.g. 'Game, Multimedia'.
field_descriptions.application_sub_category: Subcategory of the application, e.g. 'Arcade Game'.
field_descriptions.application_suite: The name of the application suite to which the application belongs (e.g. Excel belongs to Office).
field_descriptions.available_on_device: Device required to run the application. Used in cases where a specific make/model is required to run the application.
field_descriptions.countries_not_supported: Countries for which the application is not supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
field_descriptions.countries_supported: Countries for which the application is supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
field_descriptions.device: Device required to run the application. Used in cases where a specific make/model is required to run the application.
field_descriptions.download_url: If the file can be downloaded, URL to download the binary.
field_descriptions.feature_list: Features or modules provided by this application (and possibly required by other applications).
field_descriptions.file_size: Size of the application / package (e.g. 18MB). In the absence of a unit (MB, KB etc.), KB will be assumed.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.install_url: URL at which the app may be installed, if different from the URL of the item.
field_descriptions.operating_system: Operating systems supported (Windows 7, OS X 10.6, Android 1.6).
field_descriptions.permissions: Permission(s) required to run the app (for example, a mobile app may require full internet access or may run only on wifi).
field_descriptions.processor_requirements: Processor architecture required to run the application (e.g. IA64).
field_descriptions.release_notes: Description of what changed in this version.
field_descriptions.requirements: Component dependency requirements for application. This includes runtime environments and shared libraries that are not included in the application distribution package, but required to run the application (examples: DirectX, Java or .NET runtime).
field_descriptions.runtime_platform: Runtime platform or script interpreter dependencies (example: Java v1, Python 2.3, .NET Framework 3.0).
field_descriptions.screenshot: A link to a screenshot image of the app.
field_descriptions.software_add_on: Additional content for a software application.
field_descriptions.software_requirements: Component dependency requirements for application. This includes runtime environments and shared libraries that are not included in the application distribution package, but required to run the application (examples: DirectX, Java or .NET runtime).
